File surface (read on `origin/main` `ba9e0c374`; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`: `ApprovalService.reassign` resolves `to` before the audit write and refuses an address that resolves to no one with `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` naming the address; the slate, the audit trail and the approver index stay unchanged. Resolution is one private helper: a user id or an email must match a `sys_user` row and must not be provably a member of other organizations only (the same `sys_member` screen the manager and team expansions apply); `position:x` must have at least one holder in the request's organization (`expandPositionUsers`); any other `type:value` literal names no address an actor takes (`approver-address.ts`) and is refused. The check runs after the authorization branch, so a caller who may not reassign learns nothing about the directory.
- Tests: a new pin file in `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/` for the card's acceptance (refusal: status code + slate unchanged + no audit row; preservation: user id, email and `position:x` targets still move the slot). Any existing fixture in the package that reassigns to an address with no `sys_user` row is staffed with one and named in the PR.
- One `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/plugin-approvals`, declaring the break (`**BREAKING**` banner, the `(narrowing)` arm, ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`: no metadata key moves).
- Not `packages/rest` (the route already maps `VALIDATION_FAILED` to 400; no new error code), not `packages/spec`, not the escalation `reassign` action (a separate, config-authored path).
Container & model: `M`, card thread (in-session executor), `model: default tier` (`dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` on this surface: "no path-derived mandate"), `effort: high`; the narrowing owes one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review before the queue
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Basis for the Clause-② line: `no` because no published accept set or public surface widens and no error code is added (`VALIDATION_FAILED` is already this door's refusal). `(narrowing)` because the public door `POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/:id/reassign` stops accepting a `to` it answered 200 for; the full dogfood battery runs once on the final head. The request body is runtime input, not metadata an author writes, so `Metadata-protocol: none` takes `patch`.
Responsibility: `plugin-approvals` (`ApprovalService.reassign`) produces the risk | no platform path covers it: the only exit for a stranded slate is the privileged override (admin rescue) | it reaches every pending approver and every override actor through the public route; measured on `main` 77392e90 in the card body
